import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    private static Map<String, Long> v = new HashMap<>();

    public static long go(int n, int h) {
        if (n == 0) return 1;
        if (h == 0) return 0;
        
        String key = n + "," + h;
        if (v.containsKey(key)) {
            return v.get(key);
        }

        long sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sum += go(i, h - 1) * go(n - 1 - i, h - 1);
        }
        
        v.put(key, sum);
        return sum;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int h = sc.nextInt();
        
        // The Python code calls go(n, n) and go(n, max(0, h-1))
        // Note: The Python code uses the same dictionary 'v' across both calls.
        long result = go(n, n) - go(n, Math.max(0, h - 1));
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
